uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1017-2122-3921.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Winding Constrictor
Repeat.

1126-2523-2869.easyPrerequisites: There is a black card in your graveyard.
1126-2523-2869.description:
Activate Xiahou Dun by sacrificing it.
When Xiahou Dun dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Xiahou Dun that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat using the Xiahou Dun token
1126-2523-2869.notes: To do this infinitely, target the same black card each loop, and do not resolve any of Xiahou Dun's abilities.

1170-1812-2440-7517.description:
Cast the copy of Aqueous Aria spell from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Campus Composer, which enters prepared.
When Campus Composer enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}.
Resolve the spell from step 1, creating a 3/3 Elemental creature token with flying.
When the token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Pay an additional {2}{U} to repeat steps 1 through 5 an additional time, this time adding {C}{C}{C} from the Mana Echoes triggers.
Pay an additional {1}{U} to repeat the loop again, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {U} to repeat the loop again, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {U} to repeat the loop again, adding six {C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat steps 1 through 5 and step 10 any number of times.
1170-1812-2440-7517.notes: Mana needed drops significantly for each additional Merfolk, Bard, and Elemental you control.

3175-5256-5617.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

81-1394-2060-5256-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

1329-2921-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1329-2921-7340.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard this turn.
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

5195-5895-6991.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying {U}, targeting Donnie & April
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Donnie & April
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Splash Portal to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1170-2499-2733-5954-6763.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2073-5315-6522.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Mandibular Kite from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mandibular Kite enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Mandibular Kite to it.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Mandibular Kite.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

1737-2921-4853-5004.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Cathodion.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cathodion.
When Cathodion dies, Cathodion and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

413-510-2281.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Mistmoon Griffin.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin.
When Mistmoon Griffin dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mistmoon Griffin enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, failing to exile it as it is not in your graveyard and then returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Saffi enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat.

1809-1987-2493-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1809-1987-2493-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Returned Pastcaller.
When Archaeomancer and Returned Pastcaller enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1809-1987-2493-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1474-2792-3489.notablePrerequisites:
Nezumi Prowler does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
1474-2792-3489.description:
Declare Nezumi Prowler as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Great Whale's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Nezumi Prowler from the battlefield to your hand, putting Great Whale onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Nezumi Prowler's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{B} and returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand, putting Nezumi Prowler onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1733-3821-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Nephalia Smuggler.
Nephalia Smuggler does not have summoning sickness.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
1733-3821-4222.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Activate Nephalia Smuggler by paying {3}{U} and tapping it, blinking Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Nephalia Smuggler.
Repeat.
If you control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

553-5273.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain 7 life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Diabolic Tutor by paying {2}{B}{B}, searching your library for Approach of the Second Sun and putting it into your hand.
Draw Approach of the Second Sun from your library.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

1329-1379-2363-4853.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1379-2363-4853.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Hangarback Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

539-1479-2232-3585-3661.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Shield Sphere enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama and Greensleeves.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
The Badger enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Kodama.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return Shield Sphere from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Shield Sphere from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

202-2275.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
202-2275.description:
Draw a card.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and causing you to draw a card due to Lich.
Repeat from step 2.

101-2104-2665.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
101-2104-2665.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
When the token Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3525-4306-5089.notablePrerequisites:
Nyx Lotus does not have summoning sickness.
You have more than three devotions of blue color.
3525-4306-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability, causing Nyx Lotus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying {1}{U}{U}, enchanting Nyx Lotus.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding mana of that color equal to your devotion of that color.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

518-1691-1811-3733.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other creature.
You have a way to deal damage to any creature you control.
Your lifetotal is at least two.
518-1691-1811-3733.description:
Cast Ephemeral Shields by paying {1}{W}, targeting Zada.
Zada triggers, creating a copy of Ephemeral Shields for each creature you control.
Resolve all Ephemeral Shields, giving all creatures you control indestructible until end of turn.
 Cast Jeskai Charm by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving all creatures you control +1/+1 and lifelink until end of turn.
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Zada.
Zada triggers, copying Arcbond for each creature you control.
Resolve each Arcbond, causing each creature you control to deal damage to each other creature and player when they are dealt damage.
Deal damage to any creature you control, triggering their Arcbond ability, dealing that much damage to each other creature and player.
The creature's lifelink triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the damage dealt.
When damage is dealt to each of your creatures, their Arcbond abilities will trigger.
Repeat from step 6 with each creature's trigger.
